clarifications.original_wording: Each channel has its own synthetic morphology and random seed.
clarifications.precise_implementation: One PRNG is initialized per mother; channels use successive disjoint draws from that stream. The three morphology maps are generated independently of any spectral/chemical parameter model, but generators are not separately seeded per channel.
